blocks.t: Cross-sectional view of a three-dimensional map of dopant atoms (light blue spheres) implanted into a typical silicon transistor structure. Red dots represent the silicon atoms (only 2% are shown for clarity), and the gray spheres represent a native silicon dioxide layer located at the interface between the crystalline silicon substrate and layer of deposited polycrystalline silicon.
